categories.main_business_segments: Smoore International Holdings Limited operates primarily in electronic vaping products, heat-not-burn products, components for special purpose atomization products, inhalation therapy, and beauty atomization products. The company serves both corporate clients and self-branded retail markets, with a growing focus on self-branded electronic vaping and beauty atomization products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced atomization technology, including proprietary platforms like FEELM TURBO and BLAST for vaping products, and TPS technology for beauty atomization. Manufacturing emphasizes product design for manufacturability, automation, and quality control, with significant R&D investment in inhalation therapy and heat-not-burn technologies. The company also integrates intelligent sensors and microprocessors in heat-not-burn devices for personalized user experience.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Smoore serves global leading tobacco companies, independent vaping companies, pharmaceutical firms for inhalation therapy, and retail consumers for self-branded products. Key markets include the United States, Europe, Mainland China, and other international regions, with customers ranging from corporate clients to end consumers in vaping and beauty sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with major revenue contributions from Europe and other countries (46.7%), Hong Kong (32.8%, mainly transshipment), the United States (11.9%), and Mainland China (8.6%). It has production and R&D facilities primarily in Mainland China and subsidiaries in the US, UK, Indonesia, and other locations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Smoore operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on R&D, design, manufacturing, and sales of vaping and atomization products. It provides both OEM/ODM services to corporate clients and sells self-branded products directly to consumers and institutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in inhalation therapy and heat-not-burn products, aiming to commercialize technological breakthroughs and build competitive product platforms. It emphasizes market-driven R&D, efficient project management, and expanding intellectual property portfolios. Future R&D focuses include enhancing electronic vaping technologies, expanding atomization applications, and developing drug-device combination products for respiratory diseases.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales of electronic vaping devices, heat-not-burn products, components, beauty atomization devices, and inhalation therapy products. Additionally, the company earns income from R&D services provided to customers, including research and design contracts. Sales are made to corporate clients and through self-branded retail channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Smoore is the world's largest manufacturer of vaping devices with a market share of approximately 13.1% in 2024. It competes globally in vaping and atomization technology markets, maintaining leadership through technological innovation, compliance, and diversified product offerings. The company faces regulatory challenges but leverages its compliance capabilities and R&D strength to sustain its market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Smoore reported revenue of approximately RMB11.8 billion, a 5.3% increase year-on-year, with gross profit of RMB4.4 billion and a gross margin of 37.4%. The company’s net profit margin was 11.0%, with total equity of RMB21.9 billion. Self-branded business revenue grew 34%, while corporate client business slightly declined. The company invests heavily in R&D (13.3% of revenue) and maintains strong liquidity with cash and cash equivalents of RMB5.17 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Smoore emphasizes its leading atomization technology, compliance with global regulations, and strong R&D capabilities to deliver innovative, high-quality vaping and atomization products. Its differentiated product platforms offer enhanced user experience, safety, and efficiency. The company also provides value-added services such as market insights and brand promotion to customers, enabling tailored solutions and competitive advantages in rapidly evolving markets.
